annotations.title: Set what the Free plan holds

description: What a buyer gets before paying, on Test: "open" (the tool's use, unlimited), "free_uses" (a number of uses per device, or per account with signInRequired, counted by gate() without a feature: for good, or each day, week or month with freeUsesPer, counted by Toolaby in UTC), or "paid" (nothing before a plan). Whichever it is, a feature a plan sells (not marked free) is refused until bought. signInRequired asks for an account first. Takes effect on every device at its next check, with no release — so moving from "free_uses" to "open" would let copies already installed that gate with a bare gate() run everything free until they update: while copies are installed it is refused. Keep "free_uses": opening it is the person's step, once the build that gates by feature is live on the store — tell them, with the command the refusal names. The answer says when the tool key changed: then `npx -y toolaby@latest upgrade <id>`.

freeUses.description: With "free_uses": how many per device, or per account with signInRequired (at most 200 a day).

freeUsesPer.description: With "free_uses": how often they start again — "ever" (never, the default), or each UTC day, week (from Monday) or month. A daily allowance is this, not code.

tool.description: The tool id, as toolaby_list_tools gives it (like "acme--word-counter"); the short one ("word-counter") works when it names one tool.
